summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在法規收緊：食品安全法修訂、欠稅暫停出境規範、企業棄廠時員工薪資保證金提案，合規與人資壓力同步升高。另二手電子設備進口禁令將於2027年1月1日生效，料源需調整；越日在半導體與電子領域合作持續，為本地企業切入外資供應鏈帶來機會。
summary_en: Regulation tightens for Vietnam manufacturers: food safety law revision, tax-debt exit bans, and a proposed wage deposit for abandoned factories. A used-electronics import ban starts 1 Jan 2027, while Vietnam–Japan semiconductor and electronics deals open supply-chain entry points.

items.summary_zh: Điện Máy Xanh表示，2027年1月1日起停止進口二手電子設備的新規定將利好正規零售商。
items.summary_en: Điện Máy Xanh says the planned ban on imports of used electronic equipment from 1/1/2027 benefits authorised retailers.

items.title: Sửa đổi Luật An toàn thực phẩm: Cần giải quyết đúng bất cập, tránh tắc nghẽn sản xuất, kinh doanh

items.summary_en: Amendments to Vietnam's Food Safety Law draw attention; experts stress solving current gaps without blocking production and business.

items.title: Đề xuất chỉ tạm hoãn xuất cảnh khi thông báo hợp lệ nhưng người nộp thuế chây ì

items.summary_en: A proposal would force deposit collection to pay workers' wages when companies abandon operations.

items.summary_en: An investment certificate was granted for a basic chemicals production project of nearly VND 7,000 billion in Phù Mỹ Industrial Park, Gia Lai.

items.summary_en: Vietnam and Japan are investing nearly VND 500 billion in 11 semiconductor cooperation projects.

items.title: Hai nhà máy lọc dầu chạy quá công suất, Việt Nam vượt cú sốc giá dầu thế giới
